evidence.output_quote: Moving or storing outside the EPA: ESDS must be in a closed shielding bag or conductive container (primary protection).

evidence.source_quote: handling and storing Electro-Static Discharge (ESD) sensitive components
evidence.output_quote: 1. Carry only closed shielding bags or lidded conductive totes. 2. Closed bags/totes may ride on ordinary carts; open or partly filled containers need an ESD cart. evidence.output_quote: 1. Wrist strap tested and worn. 2. Pick from the ESD location; open bags only on a grounded work surface. 3. evidence.source_quote: handling and storage of ESD-sensitive items
evidence.output_quote: Store ESDS only in designated, labelled ESD racks/cabinets/bins. Keep non-ESD materials (cardboard overflow, plastic wrap, personal items) out of these locations.

evidence.source_quote: handling and storage of ESD-sensitive items
